answer: Six cloths. Six colours fixed in the vat by hands that mordanted every length before dyeing. Proof of dyer vat via dyers company is a vat of that kind: a vat the dyers company passes only after the dyer dips a cloth he actually mordanted. The dyer drops a kernel of alum into the vat, and the colour holds or it washes out. 19 invented vats take 19 dyers and 19 dyeings the dyer never made; the shale under each vat is the stone that never felt heat, and a canyon of shadow where the undyed cloths fade.
